subject: general
question: Which of the following gas is not related to acid rain?
solution:
The correct answer is **NH3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__​**

__
 
• Any type of precipitation that contains** acidic elements, such as sulfuric or nitric acid,** and falls to the earth from the atmosphere in wet or dry forms is referred to as** acid rain.**
 
• **Ammonia produced by industry is used as fertiliser** in agriculture to the tune of 80%.
 
• **Ammonia, often known as NH3, is a colourless, smelly, constricting, highly soluble, gaseous **chemical that is typically created by the direct fusion of nitrogen and hydrogen. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A colourless gas with the chemical formula **NO, nitric oxide.** It is one of the main nitrogen oxides. A free radical is **nitric oxide**.
 
• One of the highly reactive gases known as **nitrogen oxides, or oxides of nitrogen, is NO2.**
 
• A gaseous air pollutant called** SO2 is made up of sulphur and oxygen. **
